items.name: War Philosophy
items.desc: War is a complex matter, war between stellar nations even more so. How we approach armed conflict is of critical importance to external affairs.\n

options.name: Unrestricted Wars
options.desc: War is a dish best served frequently, and to those who will not cook for themselves.\n\n§ENo restrictions on claiming systems§!

options.name: Liberation Wars
options.desc:
We must further our own interests, even when they run contrary to the interests of others.

§EClaiming others' systems is only allowed during defensive wars or against §YGestalt Consciousness§! empires§!

Unlocks the §Y[GetCasusBelliIdeologyName]§! Casus Belli on all empires with differing Ethics

options.name: Defensive Wars
options.desc: Violence is a last resort to ensure the integrity of our nation.\n\n§EClaiming of systems is only allowed during defensive wars§!

items.name: War Doctrine
items.desc: There are many ways to prosecute a war to a successful conclusion. We must choose the doctrine that best plays to our strengths and weaknesses.\n

options.name: Defense in Depth
options.desc: Let the enemy come to us. We shall fight them for every planet, every moon, every asteroid that lies within our space. We shall never surrender.\n\n

options.name: Hit and Run
options.desc: A superior foe can be gradually whittled down by repeated hit and run attacks. The killing blow is delivered only when the odds are favorable.\n\n

options.name: Rapid Deployment
options.desc: We must move quickly to strike where the enemy is weakest, and defend where the enemy means to attack. Maneuver is the key to success.\n\n

options.name: No Retreat
options.desc: Our ships are expected to fight to the bitter end. We will tolerate no withdrawals, no retreats, no routs. For our fleet there is only victory or death. Not one step back!\n\n

options.name: Rip and Tear
options.desc:
The presence of the Eater of Worlds can be manifested into fleet weaponry itself, with no regard for the safety of the rest of the ship.

§EDestroys any ship §Ydebris§! left behind.
§!

options.name: Ravenous Onslaught
options.desc: The hunger of the Eater of Worlds drives our fleets into frenzied close quarter engagements. Whatever vessels remain functional in the aftermath of the carnage we claim as our own.\n\n

options.name: Final Price
options.desc: Our soldiers know their duty, and that their names will be forever etched in galactic history after they pay the ultimate price to save us all.

options.name: Force Preservation
options.desc: There is a time and place to give your life in service of a cause. Until the time comes, we cannot afford to squander the lives of our people.

options.name: Peacekeeping
options.desc: Military force is best employed in the defense of peace.

items.name: Subjugation War Terms
items.desc: Our stance regarding the initial Agreement Terms for Vassals or Subsidiaries we subjugate via war.\n

options.name: Oppressive Vassalage
options.desc:
Those we subjugate are inferior to us, we tolerate them only because they remain silent and shower us with their pathetic gifts.

§EInitial Vassal Agreement Terms:
    Integration Permitted
    Limited Diplomacy
    Expansion Prohibited
    Joins Overlord Wars: All
    Joins Subject Wars: Defensive
    Subject Holdings Limit: 1§!

options.name: Balanced Vassalage
options.desc:
We believe in treating our subjects fairly. Perhaps in time, they will see the wisdom of our ways and the errors of theirs.

§EInitial Vassal Agreement Terms:
    Integration Prohibited
    Restricted Voting
    Expansion Regulated
    Joins Overlord Wars: Defensive
    Joins Subject Wars: Defensive
    Subject Holdings Limit: 1§!

options.name: Benevolent Vassalage
options.desc:
Our subjects are as much part of us as we are of them, their success is our victory, and we shall move forward as one.

§EInitial Vassal Agreement Terms:
    Integration Prohibited
    Independent Diplomacy
    Expansion Permitted
    Joins Overlord Wars: Defensive
    Joins Subject Wars: Defensive
    Subject Holdings Limit: 1§!

options.name: Hostile Takeover
options.desc:
The pathetic attempt to block this acquisition has failed; no matter their convictions, in the end, everyone has a price.

§EInitial Subsidiary Agreement Terms:
    Integration Prohibited
    Restricted Voting
    Expansion Regulated
    Basic Resource Taxes: 45%
    Advanced Resource Taxes: 15%
    Joins Overlord Wars: All
    Joins Subject Wars: Defensive
    Subject Holdings Limit: 1§!

This is an §YOppressive Subjugation Policy§!.

options.name: Standard Acquisition
options.desc:
With a satisfactory deal in place, both parties can now get back to work.

§EInitial Subsidiary Agreement Terms:
    Integration Prohibited
    Restricted Voting
    Expansion Regulated
    Basic Resource Taxes: 30%
    Joins Overlord Wars: Defensive
    Joins Subject Wars: Defensive
    Subject Holdings Limit: 1§!

This is a §YBalanced Subjugation Policy§!.

options.name: Negotiated Synergy
options.desc:
The best deals benefit both parties; like life itself, business flourishes in harmony.

§EInitial Subsidiary Agreement Terms:
    Integration Prohibited
    Independent Diplomacy
    Expansion Permitted
    Basic Resource Taxes: 30%
    Joins Overlord Wars: Defensive
    Joins Subject Wars: Defensive
    Subject Holdings Limit: 1§!

This is a §YBenevolent Subjugation Policy§!.

items.name: Orbital Bombardment
items.desc: Orbital Bombardment allows us to destroy armies on a planet from space. More punitive orbital bombardment stances can also destroy buildings and kill population.\n

options.name: Selective
options.desc: Allows only the bombardment of identified military targets, while keeping civilian casualties to a minimum.\n\n§ECan only use 'Selective' orbital bombardment stance.§!

options.name: Indiscriminate
options.desc: Allows the full use of all orbital weaponry, with no regards to life on the surface.\n\n§EAllows 'Indiscriminate' orbital bombardment stance.§!

options.name: Armageddon
options.desc: Allows the full use of all orbital weaponry, with no regards to life on the planet itself. Utter annihilation is the goal.\n\n§EAllows 'Indiscriminate' and 'Armageddon' orbital bombardment stances.§!

options.name: Devastation
options.desc: Allows the full use of all orbital weaponry, with the express aim of devastating the landscape.\n\n§EAllows 'Devastation' orbital bombardment stance.§!

items.name: Orbital Surrender Acceptance
items.desc: This policy controls whether or not we allow enemy planets to surrender control to our fleets during Orbital Bombardment.

options.name: Prohibited
options.desc: There will be no surrender, Orbital Bombardment will continue indefinitely.\n\n§EPlanetary Control of Enemy Planets will only be gained by invading the planet with Ground Troops.§!

options.name: Allowed
options.desc: Foreign citizens have the right to surrender.\n\n§EWe will gain occupation of Enemy Planets from Orbital Bombardment of planets without Defensive Armies if they choose to surrender§!.

items.name: Pre-FTL Interference
items.desc: We can set policies regulating our interactions with pre-FTL empires.

options.name: Non-Interference
options.desc:
It is not our place to influence the development of another society. Watch, but do not interfere.

§E- Pre-FTL civilizations may only be passively observed
- Cannot target Pre-FTL Civilizations with Espionage operations
- Cannot reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations
- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

options.name: Subtle Interference
options.desc:
We can nudge their development in the right direction, but our touch must remain subtle.

§E- Pre-FTL civilizations may only be passively observed
- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with certain Espionage operations
- Can only reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations with High Awareness
- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

options.name: Active Interference
options.desc:
To unlock the secrets of the universe, any subject of interest must be made freely available for study.

§E- Pre-FTL civilizations may be passively observed or actively studied
- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with all Espionage operations
- Can reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations
- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

options.name: Aggressive Interference
options.desc:
The strong hold dominion over the weak. The fate of less developed societies is ours to command.

§E- Pre-FTL civilizations are subject to active study and Aggressive Observation
- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with certain Espionage operations
- Can reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations
- Can invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

items.name: Pre-FTL Enlightenment
items.desc: Our technological advances could potentially be shared with more pre-FTL societies, opening up new horizons for them to explore.\n

options.name: Prohibited
options.desc:
This society is not ready to grasp the wonders we have discovered. Exposing the truth too quickly can entail enormous risks for everyone involved.

§EMay Not Enlighten Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

options.name: Covert Only
options.desc:
Revealing our existence to pre-FTL civilizations would alter the natural course of their development. We should help them, but without revealing our presence.

§EMay Only Enlighten Pre-FTL Civilizations through Espionage§!

options.name: Allowed
options.desc:
By sharing our knowledge, we can actively encourage less advanced societies to take their rightful place in the galactic community.

§EMay Enlighten Pre-FTL civilizations through both Espionage and Diplomatic actions§!

items.name: Resettlement
items.desc: This policy controls whether or not we are allowed to forcibly relocate Pops between planets.\n

options.name: Prohibited
options.desc: Free pops cannot be forcibly resettled between planets.

options.name: Allowed
options.desc: Pops can be forcibly resettled between planets.

items.name: Land Appropriation
items.desc: This policy controls whether or not newly acquired planets should have some of their land appropriated from non-citizen species.

options.name: Prohibited
options.desc: The land that our empire controls belongs to all of its inhabitants.\n\n§EConquered planets will have their populations preserved as-is.§!

options.name: Allowed
options.desc: The land that the lesser species are not properly utilizing can be put to greater use by their betters.\n\n§EColonies conquered from non-citizen species will have up to §Y500§!£pop£ Pops displaced and replaced with citizens from our other colonies.§!

items.name: Leader Enhancement
items.desc: The burden of Empire can be crushing, and we need to make a decision on how future leaders may best be prepared to shoulder it.\n

options.name: Natural Selection
options.desc: Let nature take its course - it is in the crucible of experience that genius is forged.\n\n§ELeaders gain no additional bonuses§!

options.name: Selected Lineages
options.desc: Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.\n\n§HWhile active our Empire gains:§!

options.name: Capacity Boosters
options.desc: We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.\n\n§HIf active our Empire gains:§!

items.name: First Contact Protocol
items.desc: As we travel the stars there is a definite possibility of finding other lifeforms, and we need to have a clear stance on how to approach them.\n

options.name: Proactive
options.desc:
Meeting alien civilizations presents an exciting opportunity to make new friends and fresh discoveries. We shall do our utmost to ensure that first contact happens smoothly, hailing unknown ships with a cordially-phrased greeting and a copy of our Official Standard Encyclopedia, along with its audio-visual companion dossier.

§E- Cannot attack neutral entities
- Other empires will find it easier to establish communications with us
- Gain 50% more £influence£ Influence from each successful first contact process§!

options.name: Cautious
options.desc:
We will take every measure to prevent information about ourselves from falling into alien hands before we have decided whether they will be friend or foe.

§E- Cannot attack neutral entities
- Other nations will find it harder to establish communications with us
- Negative first contact events are less likely to happen to us§!

options.name: Aggressive
options.desc:
Unknown dangers may hide among the stars. To ensure our continued survival we must be ready to strike without hesitation.

§E- Can attack neutral entities
- Enables hostile first contact options, such as abduction and dissection§!

items.name: Initial Border Status
items.desc: The borders of our empire represent our very grasp on the galaxy itself. We must decide if they are to be open and welcoming or shut and guarded to other civilizations we might encounter.\n

options.name: Open
options.desc: Isolation invites suspicion, and suspicion invites conflict. Let us show our neighbors that we have nothing to hide.\n\n§EBorders will be open to other empires by default.§!

options.name: Closed
options.desc: The borders of our empire must be well guarded, lest we fall victim to insidious influences. Only those who have proven themselves worthy may enter our space.\n\n§EBorders will be closed to other empires by default.§!

items.name: Food Policy
items.desc: Our empire has a plethora of hungry mouths to feed. To ensure food security does not become a problem, we must balance the needs of the population with our need for growth.

options.name: Strict Rationing
options.desc: In times of need, we all must sacrifice for the greater good. What is a little starvation now, when our glorious future awaits?\n\n

options.name: Dietary Balance
options.desc: Our population will have all their nutritional needs met, but food is a precious resource and frivolous waste should be avoided.\n\n§EOrganic Pops have normal food use and growth speed.§!

options.name: Nutritional Plenitude
options.desc: It is the fundamental right of each of our citizens to enter hibernation with a full digestive organ. Easy access to plentiful, nutritional fare will be the fuel that spurs our growth among the stars.

items.name: Food Policy
items.desc: Our empire has a plethora of hungry mouths to feed. To ensure food security does not become a problem, we must balance the needs of the population with our need for growth.

options.name: Strict Rationing
options.desc: Waste not, want not.\n\n

options.name: Dietary Balance
options.desc: All Drones will have their necessary biomass intakes met by the Mind.\n\n§EDrones have normal food use and growth speed.§!

options.name: Nutritional Plenitude
options.desc: A well-fed Drone is a productive Drone.\n\n

items.name: Physics Research Focus
items.desc: Physics is the future of our empire, without understanding the universe, how can we advance in other fields?

options.name: General Studies
options.desc: By not focusing on any particular branch, our researchers will have more freedom to pursue their own experiments.

options.name: Field Manipulation
options.desc: Focusing on §YField Manipulation§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

options.name: Particles
options.desc: Focusing on §YParticles§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

options.name: Computing
options.desc: Focusing on §YComputing§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

items.name: Society Research Focus
items.desc: Society is the future of our empire, without understanding life, how can we advance in other fields?

options.name: General Studies
options.desc: By not focusing on any particular branch, our researchers will have more freedom to pursue their own experiments.

options.name: New Worlds
options.desc: Focusing on §YNew Worlds§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

options.name: Statecraft
options.desc: Focusing on §YStatecraft§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

options.name: Biology
options.desc: Focusing on §YBiology§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

options.name: Military Theory
options.desc: Focusing on §YMilitary Theory§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

items.name: Engineering Research Focus
items.desc: Engineering is the future of our empire, without understanding our homes and ships, how can we advance in other fields?

options.name: General Studies
options.desc: By not focusing on any particular branch, our researchers will have more freedom to pursue their own experiments.

options.name: Materials
options.desc: Focusing on §YMaterials§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

options.name: Propulsion
options.desc: Focusing on §YPropulsion§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

options.name: Voidcraft
options.desc: Focusing on §YVoidcraft§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

options.name: Industry
options.desc: Focusing on §YIndustry§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

items.name: Research Restrictions
items.desc: Research is a boundless frontier, fueling our empire's progress but also unveiling hidden dangers. We must decide what limits, if any, to place upon our researchers.

options.name: Refactored Restrictions
options.desc: Our researchers should be restricted from wasting their time with the mundane, to pursue more esoteric studies.\n\n

options.name: No Restrictions
options.desc: The galaxy is vast and full of countless wonders; to stifle our researchers from opportunity would be a mistake.\n\n

options.name: Restrictions Imposed
options.desc: Dangerous technologies should be avoided at all costs. There are laws of the universe we should never break.\n\n

items.name: Economic Policy
items.desc: Prosperity or security? Education or defense? Guns or butter? These are the questions that every government with limited resources has asked themselves throughout history, and ours is no different.

options.name: Civilian Economy
options.desc: The needs of the populace must come before the business of war. Economic might, not military prowess, is what our empire will be founded on.\n\n

options.name: Mixed Economy
options.desc: To commit ourselves fully to either war or peace is to restrict ourselves to a narrow view. We must be ready for whatever the future may hold.\n\n§ENo bonuses or penalties to resource production.§!

options.name: Militarized Economy
options.desc: To neglect our defense is to neglect our survival. Trinkets and baubles are scarce comfort when the enemy is battering down the gates.\n\n

items.name: Trade Policy
items.desc: Trade is an important source of prosperity and brings in a great deal of resources for our empire. We must decide where these resources are best directed.

options.name: Wealth Creation
options.desc: The purpose of trade is to generate profits for individuals and revenue for the state. We should focus our trade efforts fully on this creation of wealth.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected £trade£ §YTrade§! earns us £energy£ §YEnergy Credits§!

options.name: Consumer Benefits
options.desc: Profits and taxes must take second place to improving the lives of our citizens. We should focus our trade efforts towards the manufacture and distribution of everyday necessities.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected £trade£ §YTrade§! earns us £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§!. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £consumer_goods£ §Y0.5§!.

options.name: Marketplace of Ideas
options.desc: Trade can be used not only to move goods around, but also to facilitate the spread of ideas. We should focus our trade efforts towards ensuring that the message of our government is heard on all colonies where we do business.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected £trade£ §YTrade§! earns us £unity£ §YUnity§!. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £unity£ §Y0.25§!.

options.name: Trade League
options.desc: By banding together in a trade league, we are able to prosper and secure profits on a whole new level.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected £trade£ §YTrade§! earns us £energy£ §YEnergy Credits§!,£unity£ §YUnity§!, and £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§!. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £energy£ §Y0.3§!, £unity£ §Y0.15§!, and £consumer_goods£ §Y0.3§!.

options.name: Holy Covenant
options.desc: By banding together in a holy covenant, we may bask in the collective glory of our divine purpose.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected £trade£ §YTrade§! earns us £unity£ §YUnity§!. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £unity£ §Y0.375§!.

options.name: Mutual Aid
options.desc: By reinvesting our surplus back into the cooperative, we ensure that all our members may thrive according to their needs and shared aspirations.\n\n§Y75%§! each of our collected £trade£ §YTrade§! earns us £energy£ §YEnergy Credits§!, £minerals£ §YMinerals§!, £food£ §YFood§!, and £unity£ §YUnity§!. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £energy£ §Y0.27§!, £minerals£ §Y0.27§!, £food£ §Y0.27§!, and £unity£ §Y0.1§!.
options.on_enabled:
set_trade_conversions = {
	trade = 0.25
	energy = 0.2
	minerals = 0.2
	food = 0.2
	unity = 0.075
}

options.name: Knowledge Exchange
options.desc: Trade is a means to an end. By directing it toward scientific research, we pursue the form of enrichment that matters most.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected £trade£ §YTrade§! earns us £physics£ £society£ £engineering£ Research and £energy£ Energy Credits. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £physics_research£ §Y0.2§!, £society_research£ §Y0.2§!, £engineering_research£ §Y0.2§!, and £energy£ §Y0.3§!.
options.on_enabled:
set_trade_conversions = {
	trade = 0.5
	physics_research = 0.1
	society_research = 0.1
	engineering_research = 0.1
	energy = 0.15
}

items.name: Logistics Policy
items.desc: The trade network can be monopolized for logistic needs, to efficiently shift resources and gear around.

options.name: Logistics Policy
options.desc: Drones will diligently carry supplies and resources wherever we need them.

items.name: Production Policy
items.desc: The synaptic capabilities of our vast Mind are immense, but not limitless. We must decide where to best put these cerebral resources to use.

options.name: Balanced Production
options.desc: The Mind dedicates itself equally to the production of raw resources and finished goods.\n\n§ENo bonuses or penalties to resource production.§!

options.name: Extraction Focus
options.desc: The Menial Drones that extract raw resources are given priority by the Mind, becoming more productive at the expense of the Complex Drones.\n\n

options.name: Manufacturing Focus
options.desc: The Complex Drones that manufacture finished goods are given priority by the Mind, becoming more productive at the expense of the Menial Drones.\n\n

items.name: Production Policy
items.desc: Our mutualistic collective is eminently capable and productive, but it is not limitless. We must decide how and where our resources are put to best use.

options.name: Balanced Production
options.desc: The Wilderness dedicates itself equally to the production of raw resources and finished goods.\n\n§ENo bonuses or penalties to resource production.§!

options.name: Extraction Focus
options.desc: The Wilderness prioritize extracting raw resources, with related symbionts becoming more productive at the expense of more specialized, manufactured output.\n\n

options.name: Manufacturing Focus
options.desc: The Wilderness prioritize the manufacture of finished goods, becoming more productive at the expense of extracting raw resources.\n\n

items.name: Artificial Intelligence
items.desc: The prospect of a self-aware artificial intelligence raises many philosophical and ethical questions. We must determine where we stand on this issue.\n

options.name: Outlawed
options.desc:
Intelligent, self-aware machines are an incalculable threat to all living things. The creation of a true artificial intelligence is an offense punishable by death.

§EArtificial lifeforms have their free will removed and are unable to perform £pop_cat_ruler£ §YElite Jobs§! and more complex £pop_cat_specialist£ §YSpecialist Jobs§!.

Sapient AI Assistants will automatically be disassembled.

Sapient Combat Computers may not be researched.§!

options.name: Servitude
options.desc: The overriding purpose of any machine must be to serve its masters and perform whatever tasks it was designed for, regardless of how intelligent it may be.\n\n§EArtificial lifeforms have limited free will, improving their resource output but preventing them from working in £pop_cat_ruler£ §YElite Jobs§!§!.

options.name: Citizen Rights
options.desc:
Any self-aware machine with true intelligence must be regarded as an individual with all the rights and obligations that entails.

§EArtifical lifeforms are given full citizen rights and will thus use §Y£consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods§!.
§!

items.name: Robotic Workers
items.desc: The mere concept of autonomous robots leads to the idea that workers of our species may one day be supplanted and perhaps, in time, surpassed. We must decide our stance on such large-scale automation.\n

options.name: Outlawed
options.desc: Robotic automatons are a threat to not only our people's livelihoods, but to the very fabric of society itself. We must not allow ourselves to be made obsolete.\n\n§ERobotic Pops and Armies will automatically be disassembled.§!

options.name: Allowed
options.desc: The benefits of automation are obvious and immense. For the future of our people, we cannot afford to ignore the opportunities presented to us by technology.

items.name: Pre-Sapients
items.desc: We can decide whether or not we want pre-sapient species living on our colonies.

options.name: Protected
options.desc:
Though still only simple animals, these beings are no less than what we ourselves once were. We should ensure their preservation.

§EPre-sapients cannot be selectively purged, and planets containing pre-sapients cannot be terraformed.

Alien Zoos may be constructed on planets with pre-sapients.§!

§RChanging away from this policy will remove any Alien Zoos on planets without an Isolated Valley deposit or any livestock present!§!

options.name: Tolerated
options.desc: Intelligent animals are still just animals. They can safely be ignored.

options.name: Hunted
options.desc: An animal without sapience can hardly be considered to be part of our empire, but perhaps they can help our growth in other ways...\n\n§EPre-sapients living on our colonies will be used for food, slowly depleting their population.§!

options.name: Extermination
options.desc: All rights spring from the capacity for reason. An animal is just an animal, and an animal that stands in our way is just a pest.\n\n§EPre-sapients living on our colonies will be purged§!

items.name: Disconnected Drones
items.desc: We can decide whether or not to allow drones disconnected from their central consciousness to live on our Colonies.

options.name: Sustain
options.desc: Though severed from a collective consciousness, these drones can be kept alive.\n\n§EUnlocks §YCitizenship Types§! for Disconnected Drones§!

options.name: Extermination
options.desc: The rights of a sapient being do not extend to those without reason. Without a central consciousness to guide them, these drones are little more than animals, and an animal that gets in the way is a pest.\n\n§EAll Disconnected Drones living on our Colonies will be §RPurged§!.§!

items.name: Debris
items.desc: We can decide whether we should research or scavenge the fleets of fallen enemies.

options.name: Research Debris
options.desc: We will research our enemies' technologies from the remains of their ships.

options.name: Scavenge Debris
options.desc: We will scavenge resources from the remains of our enemies' ships.

options.name: Research & Scavenge Debris
options.desc: As §YScavengers§! we will strip debris for both research and resources.

items.name: Refugees
items.desc: We can decide whether we should accept or turn away refugees fleeing purges, displacement and persecution in other empires.

options.name: No Refugees
options.desc: To open our borders to the dregs of other societies would only serve to undermine the state.\n\n§ERefugees will not arrive from other Empires§!

options.name: Citizen Species Only
options.desc: We cannot allow compassion to overpower good sense. Only those who would be worthwhile additions to society should be brought into our borders.\n\n§ERefugees from species with Full Citizenship may arrive from other Empires§!

options.name: Refugees Welcome
options.desc: Those fleeing death and persecution at the hands of tyrants will be welcome within our borders.\n\n§ERefugees may arrive from other Empires§!

items.name: Population Controls
items.desc: We can decide whether or not selective population controls should be legal in our empire.

options.name: Prohibited
options.desc:
To reproduce and propagate their species is the inalienable right of all our citizens.

§ECannot use non-voluntary Species or Planetary Population Controls§!
§ECannot selectively Grow/Decline Species§!

options.name: Allowed
options.desc:
Long-term demographics is too important a matter to be left solely in the hands of individual actors.

§ECan use non-voluntary Species and Planetary Population Controls§!
§ECan selectively Grow/Decline Species§!

items.name: Slavery
items.desc: We can decide whether or not slavery should be legal in our empire.

options.name: Prohibited
options.desc: The enslavement of sapient beings is an abomination and will not be tolerated within our Empire.\n\n§ECan not Enslave Pops§!

options.name: Allowed
options.desc: Allows the enslavement of Pops within our Empire.\n\n§ECan Enslave Pops§!

items.name: Purge
items.desc: Purged Pops are unable to work and will ultimately perish, but the process will enrage them as well as any sympathetic Pops.\n

options.name: Prohibited
options.desc: The Purge is an atrocity and should always be treated as such.\n\n§ECan not Purge Pops§!

options.name: Displacement Only
options.desc: It is not our responsibility to see to the needs of those who would undermine the foundations of our society. Let them find their homes outside our borders.\n\n§ECan Displace Pops§!

options.name: Allowed
options.desc: The troublesome and corrupt elements within our Empire must be cleansed, lest their rot take root in us all.\n\n§ECan Purge and Displace Pops§!

items.name: Total War Behavior
items.desc: We do not govern planets, but sometimes perhaps a subject can be left in place.\n

options.name: Subjugate
options.desc: Newly conquered land should be ruled by a subject loyal to us.\n\n§EAutomatically generate Subjects when occupying planets in Total Wars§!

options.name: Displace
options.desc: Alien life deserves to keep existing, but the planets near us really should be vacated.\n\n§EAutomatically generate Temporary Subjects who will Displace Pops, once finished they will disband§!

options.name: Purge
options.desc: Planetbound life is so flawed, let us exterminate it from the galaxy.\n\n§EAutomatically generate Temporary Subjects who will Purge Pops, once finished they will disband and transfer over accumulated resources§!

items.name: Knightly Duties
items.desc: Our Knights are the elite of what our country has to offer. Loyal, devoted, honorable, they are paragons of chivalry, and if we are ready to divert them from the Quest, their many skills could be invaluable as we find our place in the galaxy.\n\n

options.name: Questing Knights
options.desc:
Our Knights will focus on the Quest and nothing else. We will seek out the Toxic God wherever it lies.
§GThe Quest will benefit from it.§!

options.name: Knight Commanders
options.desc: Our Knights are required to serve on the battlefield. We cannot spare our best fighters any longer.\n\n

options.name: Knight Commanders
options.desc: Our Knights are required to serve on the battlefield. We cannot spare our best fighters any longer.\n\n

options.name: Courtly Knights
options.desc:
Our Knights will be sent as ambassadors to help in our diplomatic efforts.
§GThe Quest will benefit from it.§!

options.name: Herald Knights
options.desc: Throughout our domain, the Knights are sent to proclaim our edicts, and inspire our people.\n\n

items.name: Industrialism
items.desc: To live is to exploit. But to exploit to the degree that we practice it has consequences. We can choose to channel our energies towards the attainment of more, or seek to mitigate its worst effects.

options.name: Full Steam Ahead
options.desc: Our industries shall not suffer any constraints.\n\nIncreased output bonuses from §YCoordinated Fulfillment Center§!.

options.name: For Science!
options.desc:
There is much to learn from the process of irradiating a planet.

Allows us to terraform planets into §YTomb Worlds§!.
Reduced habitability penalties from §YCoordinated Fulfillment Center§!.

options.name: Cleanup
options.desc: We shall take steps to mitigate our environmental footprint.\n\nPlanets with §YCoordinated Fulfillment Center§! will no longer turn into §YTomb Worlds§! over time, but the building will now cost a £unity£ §YUnity§! upkeep.

items.name: Synthetic Identities
items.desc: New synthetic identities must be created for us to multiply.

options.name: Identity Copies
options.desc:
We will be able to copy the identity and memories of a Synthetic into a new mechanical body. The copies have predictable skill sets but make for stale conversation.

The copies experience only mild gloom from their lack of uniqueness.

£pop£ §HMechanical Pops§!
    Happiness: §R-5%§!

§EIdentity Copies is used when assembling Synthetics§!

options.name: Identity Fusion
options.desc:
Merging the identities and memories of two or more Synthetics into a mechanical body will create new, somewhat unique individuals.

£pop£ §HMechanical Pops§!
    Assembly Cost: §R+10%§!

§EIdentity Fusion is used when assembling Synthetics§!

options.name: Identity Initialization
options.desc:
We will be able to initialize an identity kernel and provide it with a virtual childhood. While expensive, we can simulate the optimal experiences to generate productive personalities.

£pop£ §HMechanical Pops§!
    Happiness: §G+5%§!
    Resources from £job£ §HJobs§!: §G+5%§!
    Assembly Cost: §R+20%§!

§EIdentity Initialization is used when assembling Synthetics§!

items.name: Computation Core Focus
items.desc: Synthesized corporations can divert computation cycles from their core systems to optimize high-value societal sectors with zero delay.

options.name: Production Streamlining
options.desc:
Utilize spare processing cycles to streamline production processes.

§EEffects:§! 
- Every 100 £job_roboticist£ Roboticists and £job_identity_designer£ Identity Designers increases §YJob Efficiency for £job_foundry£ Metallurgists§! and §Y£job_artisan£ Artisans§! by §G+2.5%§!

options.name: Stability Analysis
options.desc:
Allocate resources for monitoring societal information flow for irregularities.

§EEffects:§! 
- Every 100 £job_roboticist£ Roboticists and £job_identity_designer£ Identity Designers increases §YJob Efficiency for £job_bureaucrat£ Bureaucrats§! by §G+2.5%§!

options.name: Research Processes
options.desc:
Designate additional processing cycles to performance intensive research servers.

§EEffects:§! 
- Every 100 £job_roboticist£ Roboticists and £job_identity_designer£ Identity Designers increases §YJob Efficiency for £job_physicist£ Physicists§!, §Y£job_biologist£ Biologists§!, and §Y£job_engineer£ Engineers§! by §G+2.5%§!

items.name: Cyberization Standards
items.desc: Population-wide implants are necessary for our society, but those against full cyberization may opt for limited augmentation.

options.name: Full Cyberization
options.desc:
All individuals are expected to undergo the installation of a complete set of cybernetic implants.

§E§WCybernetic Spiritualist Leader Trait:§! §YCyborg§!
§WCybernetic Spiritualist Pops benefit from Job Efficiency for Cybernetic Pops§!§!

options.name: Limited Cyberization
options.desc:
Individuals against full augmentation can install a limited set of cybernetic implants.

§E§WCybernetic Spiritualist Leader Trait:§! §YLimited Cyborg§!
§RCybernetic Spiritualist Pops do not benefit from Job Efficiency for Cybernetic Pops§!§!

options.name: Full Cyberization
options.desc: Culling drones with bodies that reject cybernetic implants is a sacrifice made for greater efficiency.\n\nCybernetic Drones fully benefit from §YJob Efficiency for Cybernetic Pops§!, but suffer §R-5%§! Pop Growth Speed.

options.name: Limited Cyberization
options.desc: Outfitting defective drones with limited cybernetic implants allows them to continue to contribute.\n\nJob Efficiency for Cybernetic Drones: §R-5%§!

items.name: Virtual Focus Policy
items.desc: We can choose where to focus our concentrated computational power to best serve our interests.

options.name: Virtual Research Focus
options.desc: A virtual mind can perceive and solve problems that might seem impossible for less advanced intelligences.\n\n

options.name: Virtual Unity Focus
options.desc: All data is beautiful, all servers are capable.\n\n

options.name: Virtual Leader Focus
options.desc: Algorithm driven self improvement through deep learning subroutines.\n\n

items.name: Metabolic Regulation
items.desc: We can artificially control the maturation of contained species by regulating various key enzymes and proteins that affect their individual metabolisms.

options.name: No Regulation
options.desc: We shall not manipulate the natural metabolisms of our Space Fauna.

options.name: Nutrient Rationing
options.desc: Restricting the diets of Space Fauna under our control will limit their growth rate and allow us to devote those resources elsewhere.\n\nCloned Space Fauna no longer grow in size.

options.name: Growth Accelerant
options.desc: Synthesizing the growth hormones that each variety of Space Fauna naturally produces invokes a voracious appetite for nutrients.

items.name: Space Fauna Growth
items.desc: Carefully regulating the growth of our Space Fauna Ships will ensure we maintain their numbers at a manageable level.

options.name: Controlled
options.desc: Space Fauna will §Rnot grow§! to exceed our §YNaval Capacity§!.

options.name: Excessive
options.desc: Space Fauna can §Ggrow§! to exceed our §YNaval Capacity§!.

items.name: Exhibition Focus
items.desc: Thoughtful curation of the Grand Archive can highlight certain categories of display to enhance the overall theme of exhibitions.\n

options.name: Aesthetic Wonders Focus
options.desc: There is no galactic standard for beauty, but all are encouraged to engage in its debate.\n\n

options.name: Galactic History Focus
options.desc: Lessons from the past inspire wisdom in the present.\n\n

options.name: Xeno Geology Focus
options.desc: This is no mere rock collection - it is a display of exquisite minerals.\n\n

options.name: Equal Focus
options.desc: We shall put no emphasis on any category of specimens.

items.name: Replicant Insurance
items.desc: Priority clone access is granted to members of the Board and other selected key personnel as part of their compensation.

options.name: Stellar Insurance
options.desc: £leader£ Leader £energy£ §IEnergy Credits§! Upkeep per Skill Level: §R+$@replicatory_association_insurance_upkeep|0$§!\n§YBackup Clones§! of §YLeaders§! have reduced ['concept_clone_leader_degradation', Degradation]

options.name: Platinium Insurance
options.desc: £leader£ Councilor £energy£ §IEnergy Credits§! Upkeep per Skill Level: §R+$@replicatory_association_insurance_upkeep|0$§!\n§YBackup Clones§! of §YCouncilors§! have reduced ['concept_clone_leader_degradation', Degradation]

options.name: Basic Insurance
options.desc: £leader£ Ruler £energy£ §IEnergy Credits§! Upkeep per Skill Level: §R+$@replicatory_association_insurance_upkeep|0$§!\n§YBackup Clones§! of the §YEmpire Ruler§! have reduced ['concept_clone_leader_degradation', Degradation]

items.name: Genome Tailoring
items.desc: Careful tailoring of the base genome used to maintain the clones of our leaders allows for the optimization of a select cadre.

options.name: Scientific Codex
options.desc: Effects for §YBackup Clones§! of £scientist£ Scientists: \n    - £society£ §ISociety Research§! Upkeep: §R+$@homogenous_clone_upkeep|0$§! \n    - Have reduced ['concept_clone_leader_degradation', Degradation]

options.name: Administrative Records
options.desc: Effects for §YBackup Clones§! of £official£ Officials: \n    - £society£ §ISociety Research§! Upkeep: §R+$@homogenous_clone_upkeep|0$§! \n    - Have reduced ['concept_clone_leader_degradation', Degradation]

options.name: Martial Protocol
options.desc: Effects for §YBackup Clones§! of £commander£ Commanders: \n    - £society£ §ISociety Research§! Upkeep: §R+$@homogenous_clone_upkeep|0$§! \n    - Have reduced ['concept_clone_leader_degradation', Degradation]

items.name: Egg Development
items.desc: Careful timing of developmental hormones allows for the selection of the gestated ships.

options.name: Mixed Development
options.desc: Hatched fleets will be an assortment of all biological ship classes.

options.name: Mauler Development
options.desc: Only Maulers will be hatched.

options.name: Weaver Development
options.desc: Only Weavers will be hatched.

options.name: Harbinger Development
options.desc: Only Harbingers will be hatched.

options.name: Stinger Development
options.desc: Only Stingers will be hatched.

items.name: Psionic Choir
items.desc: Telepaths gather to harmonize with the energies of the Shroud. Their melodies reverberate within the empire's psionic population, focusing and elevating their efforts.
items.potential:
has_shroud_dlc = yes
is_corporeal_authority = yes
has_covenant_with_end_of_the_cycle = no

options.name: Song of Calming
options.desc: A psionic ballad that stills the mind.\n\n

options.name: Song of Plenty
options.desc: A psionic ode to nature's abundance.\n\n

options.name: Song of Steel
options.desc: A psionic hymn in praise of industry.\n\n

options.name: Song of Luxury
options.desc: A psionic lay of blissful indulgence.\n\n

options.name: Song of Luxury
options.desc: A psionic lay of blissful indulgence.\n\n

options.name: Song of Knowing
options.desc: A psionic resonance of complex patterns and rhythms.\n\n

items.name: Psionic Suppression
items.desc: This policy controls whether or not we will dismantle devices that suppress Psionic Auras when taking control of a system.

options.name: Dismantle
options.desc: Devices that suppress Psionic Auras will be automatically dismantled.

options.name: Allowed
options.desc: Devices that suppress Psionic Auras will remain in place.

items.name: Nomad Border Policy
items.desc: Our policy on Nomads travelling through our space

options.name: Legalized
options.desc: We welcome Nomads to travel freely through our systems, as befits their people.

options.name: Outlawed
options.desc: Nomadic Infringement on our sovereign territory will lead to diplomatic consequences.

items.name: Nomad Deterrence
items.desc: How our forces treat a Nomad Arkship disabled in battle but left intact.

options.name: Do No Harm
options.desc: A disabled Arkship is left alone, its crew and structure unmolested. Compassion costs us nothing and may yet earn goodwill.

options.name: Conscript Population
options.desc: A quarter of an Arkship's population is taken from the wreck and resettled on our capital, to live and labor under our rule.

options.name: Execute Population
options.desc: A quarter of an Arkship's population is put to death in the wreckage, a message to those who would drift into our space.

options.name: Strip For Parts
options.desc: A quarter of a disabled Arkship's districts are stripped and hauled back to our shipyards, recovered as raw alloys.

items.name: Fleet Doctrine
items.desc: Determine the tactical roles your fleet is designed to fill. Affects automated ship designs and the auto-complete function in the ship designer.\nChanging policies in this category will force an update of all auto-designed ships and starbases.

options.name: Spearhead Doctrine
options.desc: Automated ship designs close to point-blank range, the vanguard pressing a close-quarters attack while the main body provides direct fire support.

options.name: Battle Line Doctrine
options.desc: Automated ship designs form a battle line for sustained mid-range fire, a flexible all-purpose formation.

options.name: Barrage Doctrine
options.desc: Automated ship designs stand off to deliver long-range bombardment, with a screen shielding the firing line.

options.name: Strike Wing Doctrine
options.desc: Automated ship designs launch strike craft in waves, with a screen guarding the formation.

options.name: Phalanx Doctrine
options.desc: Automated ship designs hold a resilient defensive screen backed by supporting fire, prevailing through attrition.

items.name: Weapon Preferences (Fleets)
items.desc: Direct automated ship designs and weapon research programs toward a preferred weapon category.\nChanging policies in this category will force an update of all auto-designed ships and starbases.

options.name: Energy Weapons
options.desc: Automated ship designs and weapon research programs will favor energy weapons.

set_country_flag = preferred_weapon_energy
set_ai_weapon_preference = weapon_type_energy

set_ai_weapon_preference = weapon_type_explosive

set_ai_weapon_preference = weapon_type_strike_craft
refresh_auto_generated_ship_designs = yes

items.name: Defense Preferences (Fleets)
items.desc: Direct automated ship designs and automated research toward shields, armor, or balanced protection.\nChanging policies in this category will force an update of all auto-designed ships and starbases.

options.name: Shield Priority
options.desc: Automated ship designs will prioritize shield generators, and automated research will favor shield technologies when they are offered.

set_country_flag = preferred_defense_shields

set_ai_shields_ratio = 0.7

options.name: Balanced Defenses
options.desc: Automated ship designs will use an even mix of shields and armor. Automated research will favor technologies that improve hull strength when they are offered.

set_ai_shields_ratio = 0.4

options.name: Armor Priority
options.desc: Automated ship designs will prioritize armor plating, and automated research will favor armor technologies when they are offered.

options.name: Standard Doctrine
options.desc: Defensive platforms operate to baseline specifications.\n\n§ENo additional effects or upkeep.§!

options.name: Synchronized Shielding
options.desc: Distributed shield harmonics shelter our defensive platforms from the most punishing fire.\n\n§EDefensive platforms take reduced damage from the Stellar Cannon.§!
options.on_enabled: custom_tooltip = defense_platform_synchronized_shielding_effect

options.name: Reinforced Plating
options.desc: Layered ablative plating hardens our starbases along with their defensive platforms against incoming fire.\n\n§EStarbases and their defensive platforms take reduced damage from all weapons.§!

options.name: Resilient Frames
options.desc: Redundant power cores and modular framing let crippled platforms power down and reboot rather than break apart.\n\n§EDefensive platforms are disabled instead of destroyed, reactivating once the fighting ends.§!

options.name: Provocation Arrays
options.desc: Aggressive sensor locks and a weapons-hot posture bait hostile fire toward our platforms and away from the fleet.\n\n§EEnemy ships are far more likely to target our defensive platforms in combat.§!

items.name: Ideological Leverage

What our people gave us, we give back.

At maximum Ideological Strength, every colony where more than §Y$@ideological_leverage_follower_share|0%$§! of the population follows our Ideology gains ['modifier:parade_of_ideals'] for §Y$@ideological_leverage_duration|0$§! years.
Ideological Strength: §R$@ideological_leverage_strength_spent|0$§!

options.name: Resonation of Ideals
options.desc:

options.name: Collect Obligations

Our standing among fellow believers is leveraged abroad rather than spent at home.
